<h1 class="sx-hero__name">Saxon Stockton</h1>

<p class="sx-hero__role">Astrophysics PhD Student · Texas Christian University</p>

<p class="sx-hero__pitch">
I pull physics out of starlight. My research measures how dust reddens the
light coming out of 30 Doradus in the Large Magellanic Cloud, and the rest of
this site is my attempt to explain work like that to anyone willing to read it.
</p>
